subject.why: The golden pocket watch is immediately recognisable, featuring a swinging chain and adorable bunny ears on top.

category.why: The object floats in the air with a slight tilt on a saturated radial ray background without any ground or props.

clean.why: No text, numbers, UI, borders, or characters are present.

framing.why: The watch and its chain are centrally positioned with ample margins on all sides.

colour.why: Bright, warm, and saturated red background provides excellent contrast against the golden watch.

detail.why: Features clean, smooth surfaces and simplified chunky hour markers without micro-textures or visual noise.

style.why: Matches the smooth, chunky 3D style and soft satin sheen seen in the reference cards.
